gen-audiowide-gf-pathway-extreme: Futuristic from the first glyph, Audiowide spaces its tile-like letters with wide gaps and no stroke swell. Pathway Extreme is a rounded, open sans with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, grounding it.
gen-eater-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens wide and stands tall, a modern sans with a lofty x-height. Beneath Eater, dark and aggressive, paragraphs would flow smoothly, each open mouth giving the eye room to keep moving.
gen-almendra-display-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big holds a constant stroke width, with terminals finishing well away from the stem. Radio Canada Big does the plain, steady work, leaving Almendra Display free to be ornate and literary.
gen-audiowide-gf-questrial: Audiowide stamps out futuristic, tile-like letters with no thick-thin shift, while Questrial draws open, single-weight shapes beneath it. Give Audiowide the larger size and let Questrial stay quietly modest.
gen-eater-gf-puritan: Puritan rounds its forms, leaves them open to the side, and gives them oversized counters for a friendly feel. Puritan supplies the warmth, easing the bite of dark, aggressive Eater.
gen-flavors-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada is a contemporary sans with tall, full lowercase and a steady line, every curve ending in a clear opening. Below whimsical, commanding Flavors, paragraphs would move along steadily.
gen-almendra-display-gf-roboto: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height. Roboto brings the standout quality: generous mouths on its round letters, clean and open.
gen-audiowide-gf-readex-pro: Audiowide does futuristic best, its tile-like letters spaced wide and drawn with no thick-thin shift. Readex Pro does quiet reading best, with broad terminal gaps and a weight that holds word to word.
gen-eater-gf-ruda: Eater is dark and aggressive, its restrained thick-thin ratio leaving soft ink traces and wide gaps between letters. Ruda has wire-like monoline strokes and a sizable x-height, so paragraphs would glide along.
gen-audiowide-gf-savate: Savate reads clean, with sturdy hairlines and open curves. Beside Audiowide, whose pencil-like lines never thicken, Savate adds a faint, crayon-on-paper rhythm that carries long paragraphs along lightly.
